name: aero.avioverse/library
title: Avioverse EASA library
description: EASA regulations with AMC and GM, and EASA definitions, read-only, each with its page to cite

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search EASA rules, EASA definitions, implementation guides, articles and the Metis manual by reference or by words. Returns matching pages with their URLs. A rule reference such as 145.A.30 ranks exact matches first.

query.description: Words to look for, or a rule reference such as 145.A.30

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Return the full text of one library page as Markdown. `id` is the `id` (site path) or `url` of a result from `search`.

id.description: The id or url of a search result

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Return an EASA rule by its reference (for example 145.A.30(e), CAMO.A.305, ORO.GEN.200, FCL.010) with its text, AMC and GM, the regulation, the EAR revision date and the page URL. A rule published point by point lists its points to request next. If several regulations use the reference (such as Article 2), the matches are listed: pass `regulation` to choose one.

regulation.description: Regulation slug from list_regulations, only needed when a reference is shared

tools.name: lookup_term
tools.description: Return how EASA defines a term, quoted verbatim with the regulation and article it comes from, plus the entry from the general aviation glossary when there is one.

term.description: The term to define, for example: error management

tools.name: list_regulations
tools.description: List the EASA regulations in the library with their official reference, the EAR revision date the text reproduces, and the `regulation` value to pass to `get_rule`.
